content_text: Shallow focus was not only available to “large productions” in the past, it was available to low-budget productions as well.  Even if you’re talking about people limited to smaller sensors like in the early days of 2/3″ HD in 2000-2007 or so, there were tools to get shallow focus like the P&S Technik Mini-35, the Brevis35, the Letus… all spinning groundglass attachments that allowed one to use 35mm lenses and get that depth of field.
